historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission appointed Omi Lang Associates, for $8,200, to plan the South of Market Park and prepare its schematic design and program.

The general manager reported that the community had approved Omi Lang Associates' schematic plans for the new Open Space park at 6th and Folsom Streets, balancing green park with children's play apparatus and a multi-use athletic court, and that an architect had been chosen to renovate the large building on the property.
The Recreation and Park Commission ratified an addition to the contract of Marquis Associates, the consultant architects for the Sixth and Folsom Community Recreation Center.
The Recreation and Park Commission ratified a $3,212,629 contract with Echo West, Inc. to build the Sixth and Folsom Park and Community Facility.

The completed playground and recreation center at 6th and Folsom Streets was formally dedicated by Mayor Art Agnos on May 1, 1990; the department noted that thirty years earlier the city had taken two South of Market parks for the Hall of Justice and the freeway.

After a public naming contest drew more than 100 entries, the Recreation and Park Commission named the department's newest recreation center, at Sixth and Folsom, the "South of Market Recreation Center."
